reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 000138 (the melody read from 000138a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. CCEH's page spells William F. Sherwin as “William F. Sherman”; the name is printed as the sources spell it. William F. Sherwin's dates (1826–1888) are from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/W._F._Sherwin; https://viaf.org/viaf/51555646 (William Fisk Sherwin, 1826-1888, composer of BREAD OF LIFE, 1877; CCEH misspells him Sherman); CCEH's page gives only the year 1877. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000138a.nwc).
